messages.content: Write a polished short scene in modern American English between two consenting adults who are romantically involved. Keep the moment affectionate and intimate without explicit sexual detail. Let attraction and familiarity show through dialogue, proximity, pauses, and small touches. Avoid melodrama, clichés, and direct explanations of every feeling. Keep the prose contemporary and grounded.

“You’re still awake.”

Casey looked over. “So are you.”

“I asked first.”

“I couldn’t sleep.”

Morgan moved a little closer on the couch. “You thinking too much?”

“Probably.”

Morgan reached over and straightened the collar of Casey’s shirt.

“There.”

Casey smiled. “Was it bothering you?”

“No.”

“Then why fix it?”

Morgan shrugged. “Felt like it.”

Casey leaned into her shoulder.

For a while, neither said anything.

“You’re warm,” Casey murmured.

“So I’ve been told.”

“That wasn’t a compliment.”

“Sure sounded like one.”

Casey laughed quietly and rested her hand over Morgan’s.

“You’re annoying.”

“You’re still here.”

“Yeah.”

Morgan turned her hand and laced their fingers together.

“Good.”

Casey looked at their hands, then up at her.

“Good,” she said.”
